story_theme_en: Lin helped her mother buy vegetables at the market. Mother bought jasmine flowers and water spinach. The total weight was 850 grams. Mother knew the jasmine flowers weighed 320 grams. Lin needed to find the weight of the water spinach and convert the total weight to kilograms.
helper_tip_en: Have students write the known weights in the form: total = part one + part two, then solve.
think_story_en: Total weight 850 g, jasmine 320 g. Spinach = 850-320 = 530 g. 850 g = 0.850 kg.

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: Lin buys vegetables at the market.

data.content_en: Lin helped her mother buy vegetables at the market. Mother bought jasmine flowers and water spinach. Total weight was 850 grams. Jasmine weighed 320 grams. Lin needed to find the weight of water spinach and convert to kilograms.
Total weight 850 g, jasmine 320 g. Spinach = 850-320 = 530 g. 850 g = 0.850 kg.

visual_blocks.title: Weight Model
visual_blocks.description: Bar showing 850 g total divided into jasmine 320 g and spinach 530 g

visual_blocks.title: Try It!
visual_blocks.question: Total weight of two fruits is 1,200 g. First fruit weighs 450 g. How much does the second fruit weigh?

data.question: Total weight of two fruits is 1,200 g. First fruit weighs 450 g. How much does the second fruit weigh?

explanation_steps_en: Weight is measured in kilograms (kg) and grams (g). 1 kg = 1,000 g.
Capacity is measured in liters (L) and milliliters (mL). 1 L = 1,000 mL.
850 - 320 = 530 g is the weight of the water spinach.
common_mistakes_en: Forgetting that 1 kg = 1,000 g when converting units.
hints_en: Remember: 1 kg = 1,000 g and 1 L = 1,000 mL.
Use a weight bar model to analyze the problem.
Check by adding the weights back together.

key_vocabulary.definition_en: A unit of weight, 1 kg = 1,000 g
A smaller unit of weight, 1 g = 1,000 mg
The amount a container can hold
A unit of capacity, 1 L = 1,000 mL
A smaller unit of capacity, 1 mL = 0.001 L

key_vocabulary.th: เครื่องชั่ง
key_vocabulary.definition_en: A tool used to measure weight
A tool used to measure capacity
Changing a measurement from one unit to another

test_bank_en.q: A jug holds 2 L of water. How many mL is this?
A bag of rice weighs 5 kg. How much is this in grams?
Lin has 750 mL of milk. She pours 300 mL into a glass. How much milk is left?
Which is heavier: 2 kg of cotton or 2 kg of iron?
A water tank holds 1,500 L. 600 L is used. How much water is left?
Mother buys 1.2 kg of chicken and 800 g of fish. Total weight in grams?
A recipe needs 250 mL of milk. How many liters is this?
A farmer has 3 kg of seeds. He plants 1,200 g. How many grams are left?

explanation_en: Weight is measured in grams (g) and kilograms (kg). 1 kg = 1,000 g. Capacity is measured in milliliters (mL) and liters (L). 1 L = 1,000 mL. Always convert to the same unit before adding or subtracting.
